To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the positive emotions of happiness and positive affect have a positive effect on character strengths.

(1) people who are happier see more growth in their character strengths than their unhappier counterparts and (2) the character strengths that are robustly associated with happiness show the greatest change over time.

(1) the character strengths and virtues are positively related to happiness and life satisfaction; (2) people who report more happiness and life satisfaction over time show an increase in character strengths and virtues; and (3) the relationship between happiness and character development is stronger for the virtues that have been robustly associated with happiness and life satisfaction in the literature.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between character development and subjective well-being, and whether this relationship varies across character strengths.
the relationship between character strength, happiness and well-being over time, in a large, nationally representative sample of adults.
how people change and grow.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
happiness and positive affect are not only associated with the growth of character strengths, but also the decline of character strengths.
the positive emotions are a precursor for the growth of character strengths, and the character strengths in turn lead to greater happiness and life satisfaction.
the positive sum dynamic of character development is a positive relationship between happiness and character strength over time.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the more you have of these virtues, the more you are likely to get more of them over time.
the positive emotions that are the by-product of the character strengths are not merely the “icing on the cake” but are the “cake itself.”
the more positive the person is, the more likely they are to develop their character strengths and become happier in the process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
character development is a positive sum game.
character development is a positive sum dynamic.
the positive psychology approach to character development is not just a feel good approach to life, but a practical and effective way of improving the human condition.
